title: Joomla! Core - [20261157] - Core - Path traversal in com_scheduler task log file name in Joomla 4.1.0-5.4.10,…
description: Joomla! Core - [20261157] - Core - Path traversal in com_scheduler task log file name in Joomla 4.1.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inadequate validation of the log file name of scheduled tasks allowed writing log entries to files outside the log folder.
